items.t: Thousands Gather to Watch Mitsukue Fireworks
items.tag: Customer Interest and Trust increase more easily today.
items.d: Last night's fireworks show was a massive success, with more than a hundred thousand people reported to be in attendance.

items.t: Blue Skies Meet Green Scenery in Mitsukue
items.tag: Number of turns until customer becomes irritated is increased today.
items.d: A recent spell of good weather and comfortable temperatures has led to a 40% increase in park visitors across the city.
A recent uptick in consumption has led to a year-on-year increase of 22% in business district revenue, with multiple brands indicating that they intend to expand their business.
Hoshigawa Weekly reports that some yakuza-run stalls are actually selling Originium slug as roasted fins.

items.tag: Customer Interest increases more easily today.
items.d: The Mitsukue Chamber of Commerce's investment seminar has attracted more than a thousand participants, perhaps helped by the baskets of fowlbeast eggs they gave out.

items.tag: Customer Trust increases more easily today.
items.d: The latest 'Top Nita Street Shops' report is out, and Soudanshitsu Mikage leads the pack with a customer satisfaction rate of 99.9%.

items.tag: Chance that Diehard Fan appears increased today.
items.d: Momoka Hanyuu's latest single tops the charts on the day of release, leading to a three-hour traffic jam as fans pack the streets.

items.t: Yakuza Troubles Brew in the Shadows
items.tag: Chance that Outlaw appears increased today.
items.d: Gang-related street violence has been on the rise in recent days, and the police remind citizens to be careful when going out at night.

items.t: Locals Complain of Noisy Racers at Night
items.tag: Chance that Street Racer appears increased today.
items.d: Locals are complaining about a gathering of Mitsukue motorbike societies that occurred last night, which attracted hundreds of rumbling modified bikes.

items.t: High Society Gathers for Trade Event
items.tag: Chance that Merchant appears increased today.
items.d: The Mitsukue Trade Conference drew over ten thousand visitors on its opening day, concluding more than 2 billion mon in expected deals.
Is this the place? What is it, karaoke? A manga cafe? I can't tell what my bro drew on this piece of paper...
...This clearly isn't a shop for ordinary people. But I'm no ordinary person.
You really do know your stuff, do you? People don't normally know these things without having witnessed them first-hand.
There aren't many people with your kind of discretion these days. You've made me want to introduce myself.
What's the saying? 'The bystander sees clearly.' That introvert brother of mine should come and have a chat with you.
Do I look like I have a lot of time? Get to the point, or stop advertising to my bros.
Who do you think I am? You've got a ways to go before you can try to sweet-talk me. Don't play any games with me if you still want to open shop tomorrow.
Did you do that on purpose? Get up, don't block the phone. Who were you calling? Who ordered you to stall for time?
*Unintelligible slurring* Bayakro *Unintelligible slurring*

I snuck out to slack off. You got anything relaxing here?
The real stuff, you say? Don't worry, my lips are sealed. Mind if I took notes? I'll use my terminal.
You got a podcast? I'll follow if you start one! You're always so interesting.
Can I get a drink refill? Sorry, as soon as I sit down here I lose track of time. Haven't felt like this in ages.
Can we get straight to the point? I have to go to work soon.
The wi-fi here's pretty slow. I'm bored. Do you sell anything else here, other than the chance to chat with you?
I don't like to rush people, but you talk like my neighbor. You don't have to start everything from how Amanohara-Oomikami cleaved open Magatsu, you know.
I still have to help the neighbor's kid with his math homework, and listening to you talk is reminding me of math. It's giving me a headache.
I was tired enough already, and I'm not sure I'll have the strength to get home after listening to you talk. I'm taking a detour next time.

You know anything about that patrol car on the street one block away? A whole crowd gathered to watch.
You know that?! Are you a gangster too? Well, come find me at the park if you ever need anything.
You talk just like my aniki. Come to think of it, you look a bit like my aniki too...
I wish the cops were more like you. They tried to take me in just 'cause they didn't like the way I looked.
What d'ya mean? Don't use big words, I never finished middle school.
Are you trying me? My boss said folks like you like to trick people into making mistakes. You pickin' a fight or somethin'?
Why you say that? You lookin' down on me or somethin'? I'll tear down your door if you don't say somethin' useful.
I'm outta here! I don't even stop for a red light, you think I'd listen to your crap?
You're not gonna talk normally, are you? Listen, *long string of Higashinese expletives*...
Is it true that you get a lot of celebs here? Do you have any photos?
Do you have the private schedules of celebs here? No, I won't take any photos, I just wanted to take a look!
I knew I came to the right person! That's what Hoshigawa Weekly said, just as I predicted!
He really goes to that dessert shop every MWF? Then eats it quietly in the park? Thank you!
You're a diehard fan too, aren't you? Who's your oshi? Group or solo? Are we kindred spirits?
Come on, this is old news, even the repost of the repost is old stuff. And you shouldn't put these defamatory photos out there.
I'm not here to listen to gossip. Schedules, I want schedules! It's not like someone so clean would have any juicy gossip anyway.
You're not an anti, are you? Where do you get your news? Don't tell me it's all message board rumors?
I knew it was fake that he comes here! What a waste of time.
What the hell are you talking about? This is pure slander! I'll inform the talent agency. You can expect a lawsuit!

I hear that this is the most well-connected place in Mitsukue? Let's get straight to the point. I've got the money. You understand, don't you?
The soundproofing here is good. Visibility isn't great, but the location has potential, and there's plenty of traffic. Not bad...
Good. Very logical. I like efficiency, and I like that you understand the market.
You come as advertised. Do you do subscription deals? All I want is some 'insider info'. We can talk about the fee.
Not many places are so serious about their content these days. Any interest in opening a branch?
A little too repetitive. You're not giving me junk data, are you?
You're lacking in a modelable sense of order. I suggest you take a course or two in business school.
I don't need tabloid-grade junk. Young people might fall for it, but I won't.
Do you have any idea how much my time's worth? I'm going to the authorities! Scammers like you ought to be put out of business!
How unfortunate. You've lost an important client today.
Got something that I need your help with, Moriuchi-san. Same deal as usual. You up for it?
Yes, there are a lot of things that can be dealt with using a fist or a knife. But it's nice to have alternatives.
Got any booze? Went to a few shops and none of them would sell to me. I'll just take a seat for a while. Hope I'm not bothering you.
You're starting to go around in circles. Stop making a kaidan out of everything, I can tell when you're stalling for time.
Sorry, but I don't have time for reminiscing. And stop refilling my cup, we've got serious matters to talk about.
We've known each other for quite a while, Moriuchi-san. Why play games like this with me? I'll see you around.
A-Are you sure the paparazzi won't find me here, Moriuchi-san?
I wish I could turn those words into lyrics. It'd be a lot more moving than generic stuff like 'always shining'.
My engagement this evening just got canceled. Should we go get some oden? What? You can make oden here?
P-Please, stop telling horror stories, you're making my stomach hurt...
Why hasn't Mio-san called me? She said she'd be here in five minutes...
P-Please, stop talking about agencies or schedules or fans! I just want to be nameless right now... I've got to go! *Sob*
What, am I not welcome here?
...No, I was looking for someone. But it's alright. Continue.
And then? ...No? I'm not in a hurry. Are you?
No euphemisms. I'm used to hearing keywords. I remember every time you dodged around the point.
Were you under the impression that we were friends? Do not try to infer my emotions.
No need to be nervous. There's just something I wanted to know. You say you don't know? Maybe a little chat will change that.
You're more of a traditionalist than you look.
Keep going. Plenty of empty space in my notebook. The more you say, the easier it is for me to write my report.
Quit with this 'someone said' stuff. Make it clear who's saying what.
Don't play the fool with me. I've heard more lies than you've heard truths.
You're not an information dealer, you're a novelist. It'd be less of a waste of time listening to my colleagues spin tall tales back at the station.

Now, why would I lie to you? The police would be after me if this was fake. Why don't you hear me out and decide whether it's worth it or not?

I tell you, all the tabloids in Mitsukue would be hot on my heels if I let this slip, but information should end up in the hands of the right people, and I've finally found the right person to talk to.
I had a feeling that you'd come, so I compiled this story based on intel that I obtained from three different sources...
I didn't make this up! I heard it straight from his mouth, you know, that mogul by the name of Mifune, as we drank together. Mifune-sama. Need I say any more?
Now, now, surely you're joking. I have the first-hand testimony as well as physical evidence, complete with tea stain, signature, and date. I wouldn't have gotten this stuff if it was fake, would I?

Now, don't laugh at me... I know it sounds outlandish, but you might find my name at the end of the credits if this ever gets turned into a drama. After all, something that's 'based on true events' needs an original to reference.

Smooth and slick is outside my wheelhouse. All I can do is tell what I know to people willing to listen. You've had the patience to listen to me, so perhaps you'll care to hear me grumble, perhaps revealing a couple of juicy tidbits about past events.

We really struck it off right off the bat, didn't we? There's this saying that a good story is like fine wine, getting better as it ages, but so many are so obsessed with money that they've forgotten how to taste wine. I'm glad you've decided to stop and listen to an old story over a drink.

Aw, I don't believe in coincidences. Everything is ordained by fate. I had such a strong feeling of deja vu when you walked through the door, because I've seen all this in a dream. You were wearing the same clothes, had the same expression on your face, and said the exact same thing as in the dream... Fate must have determined that we are to meet!

This story began with the power outage in the old district eight years ago... no, from a case before that. It was said that some geishas gazed into the mirror late at night, seeing nothing but an empty mask. They were driven mad, and some of them even committed suicide by jumping into a river... Say, how old were you that year?
A story has to be set up by the relevant background info. I'm not just reporting the results, after all. Keep listening, and you'll know whether to believe me when I get to that name.

Wait, wait, I haven't gotten to the key point yet—there's no rush, you have to know why he opened the door with his left hand and left before six... It's all foreshadowing, and you'll understand as you keep listening.

The shop had been really busy recently. It turned out there were rumors flying around that this was a lucky place for making up a relationship! I mean, all I ever did was help people find out who's been sleeping with whom. There were so many people here to take photos that I put a sign on the door which said, 'Be alone today. Avoid old romances.'

I had a customer who complained he'd been seeing the same psychiatrist for years with no effect. I asked him why he didn't change doctors, and he said he didn't want to hurt his doctor. I asked him how I could help; he said I looked like a scammer and wanted me to scam him. How rude! Then? I told him the tea he ordered was imported and would cost 88,000.

Believe it or not, I've never opened the storage cabinet in the back. Yes, the one behind the TV. It was supposedly left by the previous owner, and you can see your own death when you open it... but this place was new when I rented it. How could there be a previous owner?
Oh, look at me, I'm babbling again. Please, have a cup of tea, it'll do you good... You haven't finished your tea yet?
P-Please, don't get angry, I'm almost finished with the story... please, don't go, I mean, have a discount coupon for next time! I'll tell you the ending the next time you're here... hehe...

Please fill out a satisfaction survey before you leave. On a scale of 1-10, write 10 if you're very satisfied, 9 if you're satisfied, 8 if you're slightly satisfied or not satisfied... Yes, that's right, 8 if you're not satisfied... Hey, please don't go! The survey!
Looks like you still want to hear more, but that's all for today. I have a bunch of reservations afterwards, after all.
Oh, the money's just a small thing. I enjoy chatting with customers who enjoy chatting with me. Let's not talk about money!

The customer laughed before I did... It's like they were even more involved in the story than I was. I better change the next reservation to the morning, because the way those eyes shined was starting to scare me...

I should try the same story on someone else. The patterns on the table, the wear and tear of the plaque, or the joke of last night's stand-up comedy? Which one should I avoid? ...I guess I should've changed the topic the first time they started looking at their watch.
Why did they believe everything I said? This might be the easiest job ever... Is this even real? Can somebody punch me to check?
It's not the truth we sell—it's trust. Just look at the customer's eyes. Doesn't matter if everything you say is true, if the customer thinks you're lying.
